create_pipeline_memory_filter: create a mem0 long term memory filter pipeline that stores user messages in Qdrant and retrieves them via Ollama
configure_pipeline_valves: configure the Pipeline.Valves settings for store cycles, Qdrant vector store, and Ollama LLM and embedder models
run_pipeline_inlet: run the Pipeline.inlet method to process user messages, accumulate memories, and inject retrieved context into the LLM body
build_mem0_init: build and initialize the mem0 Memory instance with Qdrant vector store config and Ollama LLM and embedder settings
test_pipeline_lifecycle: test the Pipeline.on_startup and Pipeline.on_shutdown lifecycle hooks for the memory filter
